correctness.rationale: Only lower-to-upper source comparabilities are nontrivial. For each lower row X_i⊆B,Y_i⊆D and upper row P_j⊆B,Q_j⊆D, both quantified confluence implications are exactly P_j⊆X_i, Y_i⊆Q_j, (X_i empty ⇒ Q_j⊆Y_i), (Q_j empty ⇒ X_i⊆P_j). Partition into the empty relation; all X_i and Q_j nonempty; all X_i nonempty and at least one Q_j empty; at least one X_i empty with nonempty relation. In first nonempty class, weighted subset-intersection counts give L and independent target-upper support choices give U. In second, a common nonempty X-set S and all Y empty give C. In third, a common nonempty Q-set T and all P empty give Z. Conditions are disjoint/exhaustive for arbitrary positive a,c,b,d. Independent direct enumeration of all relation masks for four small quadruples matches, including N(2,2;2,2)=1867; finite checks do not establish general formula.
